Derek Reyes (Marcus's husband, 2x/month dinners, Q05/Q07/Q30) is a plausible sixth contact whose exclusion risks under-representing Julio's two-person dinner-table network. However, Derek's personal-text frequency is likely lower than the five selected, and most Derek-related texting plausibly routes through Marcus. Accept as carry-forward.
Hiking buddies Tom and Rashida (Q07) are mentioned but communication is monthly and logistical; they fall below the top-five personal-text threshold. Carry forward.

Diversity profile of the circle: two women (Eleanor, Catherine, Priya), one man (Marcus), one non-binary (Ellery), ages spanning 42-78, occupations spanning retired nursing admin / teacher / data scientist / improv director / ceramicist, locations spanning Rochester-Brighton/Pittsford/Park Ave/NotA and Denver. No professional-only contacts were included (Jenna Park at RMSC and CPA Marsha Gillespie were both correctly excluded as work-channel contacts without evidence of personal friendship).

social_circle.name: Marcus Reyes
social_circle.relationship: best friend (9-year improv partner, chosen family)

demographics.occupation: Director of the Rochester Fringe improv troupe; also part-time development officer at a Rochester arts nonprofit

background.how_they_met: Met nine years ago when Julio joined the Rochester Fringe improv troupe that Marcus directs; they have had Thursday-night rehearsals together every week since, which is where the friendship was forged.
background.why_close: Shared nine years of weekly improv rehearsal have built unusual calibration — Marcus is the one person who can tell when Julio is 'performing confidence versus actually having it.' They also share a working-class Catholic-ish upbringing which Julio describes as a 'shared nervous system.' Marcus was the friend who supported Julio's 2021 decision to turn down the Reston VA contractor job, and the friend who drove to Julio's house on day five of the February 2026 Mellon-rejection depressive spiral and physically pulled him out of it.

interests: cooking weeknight dinners at home with Derek
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in full but casual sentences, uses emoji sparingly (mostly the thinking-face and crying-laughing), often opens with a one-word check-in ('Hey.') when he senses Julio is low. Fluent in improv callbacks and running jokes — threads with him accumulate inside-references that go back years. Will drop a voice note instead of typing if he's on a walk.

shared_activities: Thursday-night improv rehearsals at MuCCC 7-10 p.m.
Dinner at Marcus and Derek's house roughly twice a month
Occasional old-fashioneds on Derek's back porch in summer
Treasurer-related troupe logistics (Julio is treasurer of Marcus's troupe)
Rochester Fringe Festival performance run each September
recent_text_topics: Checking in on Julio's mood after the Mellon Foundation grant rejection in late February and coordinating the diner-intervention on day five of the spiral.
Logistics for the Rochester Fringe improv troupe — set lists, next show's theme, QuickBooks questions now that Julio is treasurer.
Running joke thread about the 'Virginia 401(k) alternate universe' — Marcus's standing bit about the life Julio didn't take.
Plans for Julio's 50th birthday in October 2026 — Marcus is quietly scheming a surprise.
Occasional political venting after Democrat & Chronicle articles, especially on local school-board races and Rochester policing.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q02 ('My friend Marcus — he runs the improv troupe — told me the Virginia job would kill the part of me he liked.'); Q07 ('Marcus Reyes is my closest friend — director of the Rochester Fringe improv troupe, we've done Thursday-night rehearsals together for nine years.'); Q21 (Marcus pepper-sprayed at East Avenue BLM march); Q30 ('Marcus and Derek, both progressive, both active'); Q44 ('Marcus showed up on day five, made me shower, and dragged me to the diner. That broke the spiral.').

social_circle.name: Eleanor Simmons

demographics.occupation: Retired (former assistant director of nursing administration, Strong Memorial Hospital)
demographics.education: Associate's degree RN (Monroe Community College, late 1960s); later B.A. in Healthcare Administration (part-time, completed in her forties)

background.how_they_met: Biological mother; she has known Julio since his birth on October 14, 1976 in Rochester, NY.
background.why_close: Eleanor has been widowed since Robert Simmons's death from congestive heart failure in 2019, and with Julio's sister Catherine in Denver, Julio is her on-site family. He mows her lawn in summer, shovels her driveway in winter, and eats Sunday pot-roast dinner at her place every week. She stayed in his studio for three weeks after her hip replacement in November 2024. They are close in a 'wiry' way — she worries about him constantly and thinks he should be remarried and fully employed; he listens and sets limits.

interests: gardening in small planters on her condo patio
PBS, the Democrat & Chronicle obituaries, and HGTV
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in full sentences with zero abbreviations, frequent periods, and occasional double-exclamation-points. Uses emoji only when Catherine sends her new ones ('I think I figured out the heart one'). Sends photos of the pot roast in progress. Leaves voicemails as often as she texts. Will send multiple texts in quick succession instead of one long one.

shared_activities: Weekly Sunday dinner at her Pittsford condo (the pot-roast ritual)
Christmas Eve Mass together at St. Thomas More
Julio mowing her lawn in summer and shoveling her driveway in winter
Doctor's-appointment logistics (she shares the Medigap premium with Catherine; Julio is the on-site support)
Occasional movie nights on her couch during Rochester's gray winter months
recent_text_topics: Sunday dinner logistics — what Julio is bringing, whether Ellery is coming, whether the pot roast should be moved to 5 p.m. because of the D&D game at 7.
Follow-up on her late-February cardiology scare that turned out to be nothing — she keeps trying to un-worry Julio about it.
Updates on her essential-oils regimen and mild nagging about Julio's bourbon intake.
Coordination about a potential summer Denver visit to see Catherine, Jasper, and Nora.
Photos of Fermi the cat that Julio sends her on purpose to make her laugh.

social_circle.name: Catherine Simmons-Okafor

demographics.education: B.S. Biology, University of Colorado Boulder; M.Ed., University of Denver

background.how_they_met: Biological older sister — Catherine left home for college when Julio was fourteen, but they grew up in the same Brighton, Rochester household with their parents Robert and Eleanor and the family's golden retriever Pixel.

interests: her kids' activities (Nora's marching band, Jasper's debate)

wine (not bourbon — a running sibling disagreement)

social_circle.name: Ellery Vance

demographics.occupation: Ceramicist and adjunct instructor, Memorial Art Gallery (MAG) studio program
demographics.education: M.F.A. Ceramics, Alfred University; B.A. Studio Art, Hampshire College

background.how_they_met: Met at a gallery opening in Rochester in December 2025 — Julio calls it 'the universe being very on-brand' given his lifelong orientation toward the arts scene and his refusal to use dating apps.
background.why_close: Four-month relationship, still explicitly casual ('too early to call that anything'), but Julio experiences it as a corrective relational experience post-divorce — he describes it as remembering he 'can be present with another person without fleeing.' Ellery stays over about one night a week at the Cape Cod in Brighton but doesn't live there. The attachment is tentative but the healthiest approach-behavior Julio has shown since the 2022 divorce.

interests: long walks along the Erie Canal towpath
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts sparingly and deliberately — short messages, lowercase, no emoji, occasional photo of something in the kiln. Prefers voice over text when the conversation matters. Will leave a message unanswered for a few hours and respond thoughtfully rather than quickly. Uses 'hey you' as a signature opener.

shared_activities: Roughly one overnight per week at Julio's Brighton Cape Cod
Gallery openings at MAG and the Neighborhood of the Arts
Occasional walks on the Erie Canal towpath
Shared meals where Julio cooks (miso-glazed black cod is becoming their shared dish)
Studio visits — Julio to Ellery's ceramics studio, Ellery to Julio's synth-and-drawing room
recent_text_topics: Logistics of the weekly overnight — which night works, whether Fermi the cat is being tolerable.
Small observations about a recent MAG show and whether Julio should come see Ellery's new glaze tests in person.
Careful, low-pressure conversations about what the relationship is becoming — neither is pushing to escalate, both are checking in.
Plans for an early-summer day trip to Watkins Glen (which is Julio-normal and new for Ellery).
A running thread of photographs — Ellery sends kiln-opening pictures, Julio sends synth patches and p5.js sketches.
